note: 8 个守卫 NPC 共享统一的“外形/职责”但各自有一句独立的搞笑台词,不是同一个人的多句对话,采集时按“第 N 个守卫的台词”分别记录,不要当成一个人说的连续对话。

messages.context: 8 个守卫之一的独立台词,吐槽某人不聪明
messages.text: This guy isn't the sharpest hammer in the smithy!
messages.gloss: 'not the sharpest hammer in the smithy' 是对惯用语 'not the sharpest tool in the shed'(不太聪明)的矮人风格改写(锤子/铁匠铺),翻译时可以用中文里类似“不是最聪明的那个”的说法对应,不需要直译锤子铁匠铺意象。
messages.zh: 这家伙可不是最聪明的那个!
messages.raw: §fThis guy isn't the sharpest hammer in the smithy!
§fLast week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still the same spot but I gladly take that promotion!
messages.text: Last week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still the same spot but I gladly take that promotion!
messages.zh: 上周他们把我从守出口提拔到守入口了! 虽说还是站在同一个地方,但这升职我照单全收!

messages.context: 第 3 个守卫,夸大自己的职责范围
第 4 个守卫,吐槽自己只是在看守对面的另一个守卫
messages.text: I'm guarding the guard on the other side.
messages.zh: 我守卫着对面的那个守卫。
messages.raw: §fI'm guarding the guard on the other side.
§fI, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the Phoenix Forge, and Warden of the Holy Pickaxe, am guarding this wall.
messages.text: I, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the Phoenix Forge, and Warden of the Holy Pickaxe, am guarding this wall.
messages.zh: 我,Murdohr,Murdohr 三世之子,凤凰熔炉的统帅,圣镐的守护者,正在守卫这堵墙。

messages.context: 第 6 个守卫,极简自我介绍
第 7 个守卫,自嘲式吐槽自己看守的东西没有意义
第 8 个守卫,守着熔岩
第 2 个守卫,吐槽被“升职”成看守入口(其实职责差不多)
messages.text: Last week they promoted me from guarding the exit to guarding the entrance! Still...
messages.zh: 上周他们把我从看守出口“提拔”成了看守入口! 说到底……

messages.context: 第 5 个守卫,冗长自我介绍(带头衔)
messages.text: I, Murdohr, son of Murdohr the Third, Commander of the Phoenix Forge, and...
messages.gloss: Murdohr(以及 'Murdohr the Third')是这名守卫的专有人名,Phoenix Forge(凤凰锻炉)是专有头衔/地点名。句尾省略号表示台词被自己打断,原文如此。
messages.zh: 我,穆多尔,穆多尔三世之子,凤凰锻炉的指挥官,以及……
